items.title: Special right of termination due to price increase (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG)
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit den neuen Preisen nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie den Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum 01.04.2027 kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG). Die Kündigung muss uns vorher in Textform erreichen; eine Gebühr fällt dafür nicht an.
items.computation: The letter grants a special termination right under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG because of the price change. The termination takes effect '01.04.2027' and the letter states the cancellation notice ('Kündigung') must reach the provider 'vorher' (before that date) in Textform. The day before 2027-04-01 is 2027-03-31 (a Wednesday, not a holiday in NW), so that is the last day the cancellation may arrive at the provider to take effect at 01.04.2027. No statutory period-counting (§§ 187-193 BGB) applies here since the letter fixes a calendar date ('zum 01.04.2027') rather than a running period; the deadline is simply the calendar day before that date.

warnings: The letter sets a price increase effective 01.04.2027 and offers a special, fee-free right of termination without notice period under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG; the cancellation notice must reach the provider in Textform before that date (by 2027-03-31) to avoid the new prices.

The IBAN printed for the sender (DE70 3705 0198 0005 5592 92, Musterbank AG) is a valid German IBAN, but this only checks its format/checksum, not that it truly belongs to Musterwatt Energie GmbH; no payment instruction in this letter depends on it, but double-check before ever paying to it.
